subject: Web Development
title: CGI: Making the Web Interactive
description: Learn CGI: Making the Web Interactive in one minute.

hook.text: Static HTML pages couldn't respond to users. Every visitor saw the exact same thing.

buildup.text: CGI let servers run a program when a user submitted a form or clicked a link.

discovery.text: Web pages could finally show search results, guest books, and hit counters.

twist.text: Every request launched a new process on the server. Ten visitors meant ten programs.

climax.text: CGI was slow and fragile, but it proved the web could be more than a brochure.

punchline.text: Interactivity started with one clunky script.

quiz.question: What was a key problem with CGI scripts?
options: Each request launched a new process
They only worked in Internet Explorer
